description: Body exceeds 1 MiB — beyond the first-release limit.
notes: Harness injection (harness proxy subclass, production code untouched): every proxied body is padded past 1 MiB with the Sentinel intact; the stored entries keep the original bodies. §8.6 limit_code body_too_large on 003–008 (baselines are direct-origin and small). The classifier's size check runs only because the harness passes run.raw_observations (ADR-002).
